history.prompt: Cinematic film still, anamorphic 35mm look. Single strong practical light source illuminating the glowing fiber threads, deep atmospheric haze, restrained teal-and-amber palette, motion implied by the sweeping curves of the heavy data cables. Generous negative space, editorial elegance.

Minimalist studio composition of a modular mechanical assembly representing memory allocation, soft even light, generous negative space. Three recognisable engineered parts: a metallic rack bay, interlocking grey module blocks, and an unlatched inspection gate. Hard clean edges, matte muted palette, gallery-print calm. Landscape composition, ASYMMETRIC composition where the hero subject commands the frame off-centre, visible surface texture on the brushed metal and matte polymer modules.

prompt: minimalist studio composition of a modular mechanical assembly on a weathered concrete surface, asymmetric framing with generous negative space. A brushed steel rack rail structure with one anodized aluminum memory module sliding precisely into an open bay. Hard clean edges, one directional softbox light throwing a long cast shadow across the concrete, matte muted palette of gunmetal and slate with a single amber indicator node.
